title: ATT-05 (#7): add one virtualized web/desktop /attention inbox and persistent sidebar actionable-thread badge using Foundation shared attention state. Reuse sidebar variants, Settings, command palette, scoped routing and configurable attention.open command without a default shortcut. Scoped environment/project/kind/priority filters, explicit incomplete/stale/unavailable states, existing thread response UI, device-local reversible revision-based seen emphasis capped at 2000. No OS notifications, relay mutation, mobile UI, server authority or full-thread loads to render the inbox.
